description: Only when your user asked: requests a free local SEO check. A person emails a two-page report within three business days, covering the Google Business Profile, local basics and where the business shows up for up to three services. It is for US businesses, one check per website, five a week. No ranking promises, no prices. An SEO quote is requested with request_service (service_line seo).

city.description: The city the business is in

state.description: US state, such as GA or SC

website.description: Website address, if it has one

google_business_profile.description: Its Google Business Profile link or name, if it has one

notes.description: Anything else the user wants a person at Managed Nerds to know

services.description: Up to 3 services to check where the business shows up for, such as "plumber"

user_approved.description: True only when the user asked for this

user_request.description: What the user asked for, in their words

name: request_seo_check

due_by.description: When the two-page check is due

message.description: What happens next, in words to relay to the user

status.description: pending_confirmation (a confirm link is waiting for the user) or requested (a person has it)

title: Request a local SEO check
